usedFor: Asana holds the team's tasks, and Apify scrapes with “Run Actor Task” whenever “New Task Created in Selected Project” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana, then “Run Actor Task” in Apify
bestTemplate.why: A research request filed as a task starts the matching Apify task, with the request details as input.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Selected Project” is polling and fires once per task, oldest first.
